title: Conditional κ = 0.001656193765416678: gauge44 without K-triangles (56 cold ends), with layered ends
body:
## Summary

Conditional κ = **0.001656193765416678** (conservative 0.001656193762539939). This is +2.00×10⁻⁶ over PR658 (0.001654192296855146) and +2.09×10⁻⁶ over our PR656.

**Change: remove the K-triangles from PR645's gauge44 construction.** PR645 keeps four (p,−1) K-triangles from the PR622 lineage. They save 12 helpers per call, but each triangle incidence lifts one own-row half of a block, so the six triangle blocks {0,1,2,11,12,13} pair at rank 2 instead of 4. That is why gauge44 stops at 44 rank-four cold ends (56 − 12). We remove all four triangles (R = 504) **and** give the six former triangle blocks the same 6-row completion priority as blocks 3–10. Removal alone restores no ends. With the shared priority, every block pairs at rank 4 and the word has **56 rank-four cold ends**.

On top of that word, the PR655 layers are re-ported: 6 cost-neutral pivot swaps, entering ends s4 (U24) and x30 (U30), six dim-8 cold ends (b6) and q4. p123 and j3 do not apply on this word and are omitted. Width 3800 per call, profile {1:2534, 2:346, 3:458, 4:178, 5:56, 8:8}. The owner map sits exactly at this word's packing ceiling (idle 2364 × rank-48). It was produced with a joint multi-call search in the style of PR653/PR658.

**Code:** `code/` and `verify_global.py` are byte-identical to PR655's reviewed set (PR589 bit supplier, layer controls, spot-width rule). New construction drivers: `construction/notri/reproduce_notri.py`, which rebuilds the no-triangle word (sha 3e99ba77) and pins the pairing ranks to [4]×14, and `construction/layers_np/reproduce_np.py` (the layered word a9de804f, with 59 pinned layer-end controls). `--control-g44` in the notri driver reproduces PR645's word exactly. The SPEC spot helpers move to [270,282,294,306], the identity image of the helper map at R = 504.

**Independent review:** SOUND. The reviewer rebuilt both words bit-exact, replayed them exactly (0 bad rows, all orientations, dyadic, no ended-helper reads), and checked (N) for all pairs, the 59 controls, audit_local and the 192-bit payload. Its own verify_global reproduces this κ. It also re-signed the final package tree, including a clean-copy rebuild.

## Verification

From a fresh clone of commit 4982f0ca, with no reused artifacts (Windows, CPython 3.11.11):
- `verify_manifest.py`: PASS, 104 files
- `reproduce.py --until word`, then `reproduce_notri.py`: **PASS no-triangle scalar word 3e99ba77…**
- `reproduce_np.py`: rebuilt the layered word; **PASS layer-end-controls** (59)
- `audit_local.py`: PASS_INDEPENDENT_EXACT_FORWARD_AND_DUAL_ENDPOINT_FRAMES_ENTRANCES_CONES
- `verify_global.py`: PASS invoice, assembly, admission-controls and bit-supplier-controls; **PASS_GAUGE44_NATIVE_EXACT_GLOBAL_ASSEMBLY 0.001656193765416678**

Rebuild comparison note: the rebuilt locals equal the strict locals byte for byte, except two `seconds` timing fields (CLIFFORD-REVIEW, SCALAR-FRAME-AUDIT), which match once normalised. Nothing else is normalised.

## Scope

Conditional on PR645's premises and on PR589's bit-supplier assumptions in place of PR543's. No unconditional theorem or Lean certification is claimed.

## Credits

- **icekylinx** (PR645): gauge44 construction, package and verifier.
- **jeremydiviney** (PR658) and **jaymosley07** (PR653): the multi-call owner search our map builds on.
- PR589 lineage (bit supplier); the PR601/604/617/622/627/635 lineage and every upstream contributor credited in PR645.

Prepared with Claude Code (Anthropic).
